entries.33eedafb39ca857a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,564 million, down 0.6% from the previous year. The Inside Sales Outsourcing Business was ¥4,630 million, the Training Business ¥2,381 million, and the Process and Technology Business ¥1,552 million. The main reason for the decline was that Tōtaru Sapōto Co., Ltd. left the scope of consolidation following the transfer of its shares.

It provides training in IT skills, ICT utilization skills and business skills through open courses, e-learning and company-specific training, and new employee training for companies accounts for about 4 tenths of sales. Its bases are the head office in Chuo-ku, Tokyo and the Osaka office. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,381 million.
